Private Function Note(e As Long, v As Variant) As String
    If e <> 0 Then
        Note = "e" & e
    ElseIf IsObject(v) Then
        Note = "Object " & TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Note = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Note = "Empty"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Note = TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Note = CStr(v)
    ElseIf Len(CStr(v)) > 40 Then
        Note = TypeName(v) & " " & Len(CStr(v))
    Else
        Note = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function
Private Sub Fill(ws As Object)
    Dim r As Long
    For r = 1 To 5
        ws.Cells(r, 1).Value = r
        ws.Cells(r, 2).Value = Chr(96 + r)
    Next
    ws.Range("C1").Value = 10
    ws.Range("C2").Value = "x"
    ws.Range("C4").Value = True
    ws.Range("C5").Value = CVErr(xlErrNA)
    ws.Range("D1:E1").Value = Array(1, 2)
    ws.Range("D2:E2").Value = Array(3, 4)
    ws.Range("D3:E3").Value = Array(5, 6)
    ws.Range("F1").Value = 3
    ws.Range("F2").Value = 1
    ws.Range("F3").Value = 2
    ws.Range("G1:J1").Value = Array("p", "q", "r", "s")
    ws.Range("G2:J2").Value = Array(1, 2, 3, 4)
End Sub

Private Function Note(e As Long, v As Variant) As String
    If e <> 0 Then
        Note = "e" & e
    ElseIf IsObject(v) Then
        Note = "Object " & TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsNull(v) Then
        Note = "Null"
    ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
        Note = "Empty"
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Note = TypeName(v)
    ElseIf IsError(v) Then
        Note = CStr(v)
    ElseIf Len(CStr(v)) > 40 Then
        Note = TypeName(v) & " " & Len(CStr(v))
    Else
        Note = TypeName(v) & " " & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function
